title: CLI action classification
responsibility: Reduces CLI arguments to the known command action used for attribution.

inputs.name: commandAction.args
inputs.description: CLI arguments after the executable and script names have been removed, where args[0] is the top-level command and args[1] is the optional subcommand. args[1] matters only when args[0] names a command with listed subcommands, later entries are ignored, and an empty array is treated as the command 'help'.

outputs.name: commandAction
outputs.description: The action label for the arguments: one of the top-level actions (new, generate, info, audit, response-check, impact) is returned unchanged, a command with listed subcommands returns 'command subcommand' when args[1] is listed and 'command help' otherwise, and any other command name returns 'help-or-unknown', except inherited Object.prototype names, which throw. The label never names a subcommand outside the implementation's lists.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when args[0] is an inherited Object.prototype property name, such as 'constructor', 'toString', or '__proto__', because subcommands[command] is then a truthy value without an includes method. Every other string, including the empty string, returns a label normally.
